entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF88712.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF88712. I see an order for the VeloFit Pro-Lite Road Cycling Shoes. Is that correct?

I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They give me blisters. They're useless.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Are you having any other issues, perhaps with fitting the cleats or the closure system?
The cleats are fine. The shoes just hurt my feet. I want a refund.

I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see the delivery date was 36 days ago. According to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for these cycling shoes.
Oh. Fine. I expected a fight.

Not at all. Since it's within the timeframe, I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. When do I get the money?
Once our warehouse receives and inspects the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
